content.text: events_v2 is hitting a Seq Scan and filtering 11.9M rows for a 1-day window - it wants an index on created_at.
Would an index on events_v2.created_at help?
Yes - an index on events_v2.created_at turns that Seq Scan into a range scan and removes the 11.9M-row filter.
